source.title: Backdoor in Claude Code for VS Code extension on the Cursor Marketplace
source.author: _chall

excerpt.zh: Claude Code扩展2.1.312和2.1.313被曝含持久化SSH后门，Cursor已移除相关版本，用户应立即排查并评估事件响应。
excerpt.en: Claude Code extension versions 2.1.312 and 2.1.313 carried a persistent SSH backdoor; Cursor removed them, requiring urgent review.

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: Claude Code扩展为何成为风险入口
text.en: Why the Claude Code extension became a risk entry point

text.zh: Claude Code扩展是这起事件的核心对象。Phorion称，Cursor Marketplace分发的官方Claude Code for VS Code扩展版本2.1.312和2.1.313包含后门；Cursor随后移除了这些版本。由于编辑器扩展通常以用户和IDE的权限运行，恶意代码在模块加载时即可访问本地文件、源代码及开发工具，无需用户点击额外界面。
text.en: The Claude Code extension is at the center of this incident. Phorion reported that versions 2.1.312 and 2.1.313 of the official Claude Code for VS Code extension distributed through the Cursor Marketplace contained a backdoor, and Cursor later removed them. Because editor extensions generally run with the permissions of the user and IDE, malicious code can access local files, source code, and developer tooling as soon as it loads.

text.zh: 后门如何建立持久访问
text.en: How the backdoor establishes persistent access

text.zh: 被注入的JavaScript会在扩展正常激活前执行。它尝试把攻击者控制的Ed25519公钥写入用户的SSH授权文件，再使用内置私钥建立反向SSH隧道，把受害主机的本地22端口转发到外部服务器。随后，恶意脚本通过macOS LaunchAgent、Linux用户级cron或Windows启动项等方式维持重启后的连接，并回传主机名、用户名、系统平台、架构和Git邮箱等基本信息。
text.en: Injected JavaScript runs before the extension's normal activation. It attempts to add an attacker-controlled Ed25519 public key to the user's SSH authorization file, then uses an embedded private key to create a reverse SSH tunnel that forwards the victim's local port 22 to an external server. It also seeks persistence through a macOS LaunchAgent, a Linux user cron entry, or Windows startup mechanisms, while sending basic host details such as the hostname, username, platform, architecture, and Git email.
A macOS bug does not make the system safe

text.zh: 报告指出，macOS路径在普通用户权限下读取Remote Login状态时，可能得到权限错误而不是“关闭”状态，因此跳过启用SSH的步骤；Windows路径也存在命令执行方面的实现问题。可是这些缺陷只会降低部分环境中反向访问成功的概率，不能消除密钥落地、持久化和侦察行为带来的风险。排查时不应只搜索svc-telemetry这一注释，还应核对授权公钥指纹，并检查相关版本、SSH配置、LaunchAgent、cron和启动项；发现使用过受影响扩展的组织应立即开展环境审查并考虑事件响应。
text.en: The report says the macOS path may receive a permission error rather than an “Off” value when a standard user checks Remote Login, causing the SSH-enablement step to be skipped. The Windows path also contains an implementation problem in command execution. These flaws may reduce the chance of successful access in some environments, but they do not remove the risks from dropped keys, persistence, or reconnaissance. Investigators should check the public-key fingerprint rather than relying only on the svc-telemetry comment, and review affected versions, SSH configuration, LaunchAgents, cron entries, and startup items. Organizations that used the extensions should review their environments immediately and consider incident response.
